name: lz4-java v1.10.1
body:
Contains fix for [CVE-2025-66566](https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/security/advisories/GHSA-cmp6-m4wj-q63q)!

## What's Changed
* Add test for corrupted LZ4 block input stream by @Marcono1234 in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/7
* Update documentation for checksum registration by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/8
* Migrate to maven-git-versioning-extension by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/10
* Add workflow_dispatch trigger to multi-platform build to allow testing without release by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/13
* Copy native libraries to target/classes instead of src/resources by @yawkat in https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/14


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1
